notes.title: Simple Dot Update & Winter Sale - Version 1.15
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34931123/e4279c74a1628e81b83f10441b52fb1e5e00d4f5.png[/img]

[b]Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year![/b]

[*] NEW - automatic synchronization with steam - performs a seamless synchronization on new devices and fixes ranking issues caused by previous bugs,
[*] NEW - button to force synchronization with steam - the possibility of manual synchronization using the button in the settings.
[/list] 

[h1]Winter Sale[/h1]
Simple Dot is available with a 30% discount until 10:05 am PST on January 5.

notes.title: Simple Dot Update - Version 1.14
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34931123/4377b6ce01b0854751b71480c088dadf15257742.png[/img]
Today's update fix a few bugs and introduces several improvements. 

Full list of changes:
- CHANGED: The Draw direction of repulsive line has been changed - now it is from left to right
- CHANGED: Shortcuts to lines are displayed as numbers only (without special characters)
- CHANGED/BUGFIX: The line must cost at least 1 point (so it must be visible) to be drawn and counted - added to prevent missclicks
- CHANGED/BUGFIX: On Level 47 - the small pushers at the bottom have been slowed down a little so that they don't cause problems when pushing the balls
- BUGFIX: Level select menu update bug fixed
- BUGFIX: When you turn off leaderboards, player panel will don't show your score after restart the game.
- BUGFIX: ESC bug when start a level from the level selection screen
- BUGFIX: ESC bug when you restart a level from the level endscreen
- BUGFIX: Line availability at level 24

Let me know what do you think about it :)

notes.title: Simple Dot Autumn Update - Version 1.09
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34931123/0fb925aa210a8b49263aec58560fb9d303221c61.png[/img]
New 'autumn' levels and three new mechanics have been added to the game today. 
Let me know what you think about it :)

notes.title: Simple Dot Update - Version 1.08
notes.content:
List of changes:
- New setting - option to set the FPS limit to 60
- New setting - option to turn on display of the current FPS
- V Sync is now enabled on quality settings: medium, high, very high and ultra (very low and low do not have V Sync)
